title: Maps load styles from unpkg and pin images from a third-party GitHub repository at run time
steps: Open /nearby as a guest: requests go to unpkg.com (2 stylesheets) and raw.githubusercontent.com/pointhi/leaflet-color-markers/master (pin image).
expected: Map CSS and marker images served from the app (leaflet is already a dependency) or a pinned, integrity-checked source.
actual: CSS without integrity check; images from a mutable branch of a stranger's repository; visitor IPs sent to both.
impact: If the repository changes or disappears, pins break or show other images; unnecessary third-party data flow; GitHub raw is not a CDN for production traffic.
fix: Import leaflet/dist/leaflet.css via a copied static file in public/vendor, copy the marker PNGs into public/brand/map-pins, and remove unpkg/raw.githubusercontent from CSP and next.config images.
